decisions.reason: Hard gates pass, but candidate 02 has smaller source-relative count and clustering shifts with equivalent approved tissue geometry.

decisions.coupling: Added immune nuclei remain within authorized changed tissue; all quota, seam, compatibility, distribution and density gates pass with score 0.887.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and support-exterior instances remain unchanged.
decisions.limitations: The target population is denser, more numerous and more clustered than source, although within the frozen gate. Mask-only evidence does not establish generated-H&E quality.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 02 as the single mask-condition handoff.
